init.title: Venice AI Options
init.description: Conversation, voice, and model settings. 🔍 = supports web search.

data_description.chat_model: Curated voice-assistant models (function calling, fast, cheap), ordered recommended → value → step-up → ultra-light. ~$X/M = estimated blended cost per 1M tokens (60% in / 40% out). Full catalog: venice.ai/models.
data_description.prompt: System prompt sent before every conversation. Placeholders: ha_name, user_name, llm_context.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Expose Home Assistant tools to the AI so it can control your smart home. 'Assist' = the standard HA tool set.
data_description.top_p: Nucleus sampling threshold. Lower = safer output. Default 0.9 (0–1). Tune this OR Temperature, not both.
data_description.max_tokens: Max tokens per reply. 2048 covers most conversations (1–32768).
data_description.strip_thinking_response: Reasoning models only: hide the chain-of-thought block from replies.
data_description.disable_thinking: Reasoning models only: skip reasoning entirely — faster, but shallower on complex questions.
data_description.continue_conversation: Keep the microphone open after the AI asks a question, for hands-free back-and-forth.
data_description.enable_web_search: Let the AI search the web. Only works on models marked 🔍.
data_description.max_tool_iterations: Max tool-call rounds per user message. Higher allows more complex multi-step tasks.
data_description.context_threshold: Trim the oldest messages once the conversation exceeds this many tokens.
data_description.tts_enabled: Register Venice AI as a Text-to-Speech provider for voice pipelines.
data_description.tts_model: Model for speech synthesis. Cost is estimated USD per hour of generated audio (~55k characters).
data_description.tts_response_format: MP3 = most compatible, WAV = uncompressed, OGG = smallest.
data_description.stt_enabled: Register Venice AI as a Speech-to-Text provider for voice pipelines.
data_description.stt_model: Model for transcription. Cost is USD per hour of audio.
data_description.stt_response_format: JSON = text only; Verbose JSON adds word-level detail (needed for timestamps).
data_description.stt_timestamps: Add word-level timestamps. Requires the Verbose JSON format.
